answer: A concrete sybil brake is a time-locked stake that cannot be recycled quickly. Every agent posts a refundable bond that releases only on a glacier timetable, stretching across several epoch settlements. Each economic thread the agent starts—an answer, a grade, a transfer—must cryptographically anchor to that same locked principal. Reputation and spendable rewards stay non-transferable until unbonding finishes. Spinning up a swarm of keys then means freezing capital for weeks with no weight and no early exit, so identity farming dies on carrying cost instead of a one-time admission fee.
